text:
maria: Hey team — my PR #4521 (SDK streaming examples + migration note) just hit docs CI failures. Preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.dev/pr/4521 :/ 

docs-preview-bot: Preview deployed: https://preview.redwood-inference.dev/pr/4521 — checks: linkcheck FAILED, vale WARNINGS, markdownlint OK

jordan: Can you paste the failing lines from the CI output?

maria: Sure — linkcheck output: 
```
LinkCheckError: 1 broken link found:
  - /docs/guides/v1-to-v2/migration#streaming -> 404 Not Found
```
vale output: 
```
docs/guides/sdk-streaming.md:45: warning: Don't use 'simply' (weasel words)
docs/guides/sdk-streaming.md:102: error: Title-case-paragraph (prose)
```

sam: Looks like the broken link is a relative anchor that changed during the migration guide rename. If you change the anchor to `#streaming-api` it should fix linkcheck.

maria: Good catch. I have the anchor in the migration guide as `#streaming-api` but the SDK snippet references `#streaming`. I'll update the snippet.

katie: For the vale warning: swap "simply" -> "easily" or rephrase to avoid filler. Also the title-case thing can be fixed by lowercasing the paragraph or marking it in .vale.ini exclude if it's a code block.

maria: Proposed patch: 
```diff
- See below for a simple example that simply streams tokens.
+ See below for an example that streams tokens in real time.
```

jordan: That wording is good. For the anchor fix, the sed I used locally: 
```
sed -i 's/#streaming/#streaming-api/g' docs/guides/sdk-streaming.md
```

maria: Running the sed locally + re-run Vale and linkcheck — local CI passes. Re-pushing in ~2m.

docs-preview-bot: New preview: https://preview.redwood-inference.dev/pr/4521 — checks: all GREEN :white_check_mark:

release-manager: Quick question — can we merge this before the 18:00 PST release window? It's a docs-only change but the migration guide is referenced by the release notes. If it's green I'd prefer to merge now but hold the release notes update until after cut.

maria: If everyone is ok, please :eyes: and then I can merge. No code changes.

sam: :eyes: — looks fine to me.

katie: :shipit: from docs.

jordan: +1 — merging after CI green is fine.

maria: Thanks all — merging now (will wait 5m in case anyone wants to revert)
